name: Pricing Optimizer AI
description:
Stop pricing your SaaS from instinct. Pricing Optimizer AI helps founders set a first price or rethink an existing one against products buyers already compare.

Give Claude a public product URL—or describe an unpublished product—to find relevant competitors, inspect their current plans, prices, and vendor-described features, and see observed pricing changes over time. Claude can use that source-backed evidence to recommend where your pricing should land. Every material price links to the public vendor page behind it.

Listed pricing pages are checked weekly. The catalog keeps one public regional and currency view per product and includes only products with at least one public price or free plan. No Pricing Optimizer AI account or API key is required. Do not submit confidential material.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pricing Optimizer AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pricing Optimizer AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://pricingoptimizerai.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Pricing Optimizer AI MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Pricing Optimizer AI scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pricing Optimizer AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing Optimizer AI provides these MCP tools: find_pricing_competitors, get_pricing_details, and get_pricing_history.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pricing Optimizer AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Pricing Optimizer AI in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, StatCite, and ClickHouse Cloud MCP Server.

_published_faq.name: Does Pricing Optimizer AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing Optimizer AI does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Pricing Optimizer AI is developed by Pricing Optimizer AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
